notificaciones.title: Giralda and the Patio of the Orange Trees – June 7th

original_visit.admin_name: Visita Catedral y Giralda (Incluye Iglesia de El Salvador)
original_visit.commercial_name: Visit to the Cathedral and Giralda (Includes Church of El Salvador)
original_visit.description:
The Cathedral of Seville and the Giralda in an exclusive visit of the most significant spaces inside, the splendor of the main altarpiece from inside the chapel.

We recommend you complement your visit with our audioguides, available in Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Chinese and Korean.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

We inform you that, starting on Monday, June 8, cultural visits to the Giralda Tower will begin at 9:30 a.m.

From 9:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m., visitors will be able to access the Tower, the Main Sacristy, the Chapter House, and the Treasury. The Cathedral will remain closed until 11:00 a.m. due to religious services.
